# anthropic_deployment_runs (Data Source)

Lists deployment runs, newest first. A run is one firing of a deployment's schedule.

~> The Managed Agents API is in beta. This resource needs `api_key` (a regular workspace API key, not an Admin key) and `workspace_id` when the key can reach more than one workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every run of one scheduled deployment.
data "anthropic_deployment_runs" "nightly" {
  deployment_id = anthropic_deployment.nightly_report.id
}

# Only the failures, for alerting on a schedule that has started breaking.
data "anthropic_deployment_runs" "failures" {
  deployment_id = anthropic_deployment.nightly_report.id
  has_error     = true
}

output "recent_failure_count" {
  value = length(data.anthropic_deployment_runs.failures.runs)
}

# A run has either a session or an error, never both.
output "sessions" {
  value = [
    for r in data.anthropic_deployment_runs.nightly.runs : r.session_id
    if r.session_id != null
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `created_at_gte` (String) Only runs created at or after this RFC 3339 time.
- `created_at_lte` (String) Only runs created at or before this RFC 3339 time.
- `deployment_id` (String) Restrict to one deployment. Omit to list every deployment in the workspace. A well-formed id that matches no deployment returns an empty list; a malformed id is rejected with `Invalid deployment ID`.
- `has_error` (Boolean) `true` returns only failed runs, `false` only runs that created a session. Omit for both.
- `trigger_type` (String) Restrict to runs with this trigger, for example `schedule`.

### Read-Only

- `runs` (Attributes List) Runs, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runs))

<a id="nestedatt--runs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `runs`

Read-Only:

- `agent_id` (String) Agent the run executed.
- `agent_version` (Number) Agent version the run was pinned to.
- `created_at` (String) When the run was created (RFC 3339).
- `deployment_id` (String) Deployment that fired (`depl_...`).
- `error_json` (String) The run's error, verbatim as JSON; null when the run did not fail. It is exposed raw because its populated shape is not documented; decode it with `jsondecode`.
- `id` (String) Run id (`drun_...`).
- `session_id` (String) Session the run created (`sesn_...`); null when the run failed before a session existed. A run has either this or `error_json`.
- `trigger_scheduled_at` (String) Scheduled firing time for a `schedule` trigger (RFC 3339); null for other trigger types. This is the slot the run belongs to, which can differ from `created_at`.
- `trigger_type` (String) What caused the run, for example `schedule`.
